row:
I have 15 years of experience in the field of pet medicine, I used to be a lecturer at a medical university, veterinary faculty. Due to time and life pressure, I quit my teaching job and returned to work at the veterinary hospital in the countryside where I was born. My daily job is to go to people's houses to vaccinate, prevent, examine and treat dogs, cats, goats, sheep, pigs... with a love for animals, especially dogs. Every day I witness where I live, people eat and sell dogs, which makes an animal lover like me feel sorry for those dogs. Today I decided to come back with videos about my life, my work and the dogs I help treat ------------------
⭐ Welcome to Animal THP
⭐ WE LOVE YOU ALL
⭐ Thank you for supporting us
